mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility raises weekday foot traffic and lunch-hour spending, so RETAIL_REC should be higher over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks if workplace attendance keeps improving.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays flat or falls while RETAIL_REC still rises over the next 28 days, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated, more shopping is substituted into nearby trips and convenience purchases, causing RETAIL_REC to decline within one to two weeks as people stay home more.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +10 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES increases exposure to downtown and corridor retail, so RETAIL_REC should improve over the next four weeks when both commuting proxies strengthen together.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise for at least two weeks but RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week mean over the next month, reject the mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT indicates capacity cuts or renewed caution that directly suppresses discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC should weaken within one week after a large transit decline.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC does not decline in the following week, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS mobility absorbs discretionary time outdoors and delays shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should fall over the next two weeks when park use accelerates sharply.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If PARKS rises by more than 10 points and RETAIL_REC does not weaken within 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A combined increase in GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL means households are consolidating errands locally, which pulls spending away from discretionary retail and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both rise but RETAIL_REC does not trend lower over the next 28 days, reject the hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: When both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are above their recent local lows, the city is operating under looser movement constraints, and retail visits typically recover after a short lag of one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each rise for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: After a steep prior drop in PARKS, leisure trips shift back toward commercial destinations, causing RETAIL_REC to rise over the next four weeks as outdoor crowding eases.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0 after being above 10 in the prior week
failure_condition: If PARKS drops below 0 after a week above 10 but RETAIL_REC does not rise above its prior four-week mean within 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.
